claim: Anomaly is a detection result entity with type (emotion_spike/emotion_drop/unusual_pattern/data_gap/outlier), severity (low/medium/high/critical), context, recommendations, and acknowledged flag.

AnomalyDetectionService is a domain service that detects anomalies in student emotion Records using standard-deviation spike/drop detection, consecutive-deviation pattern analysis, and data-gap detection.
AuditLog is an audit entry entity recording create/update/delete mutations with id, timestamp, entityType, entityId, operation, actor, and before/after change snapshots.
AuditService is an application service that wraps AuditLog factory functions and AuditLogRepository to automatically capture data mutations for compliance and debugging.

Backup is a point-in-time snapshot entity with id, timestamp, size, recordCount, SHA-256 checksum, status lifecycle (pending/in_progress/completed/failed), and metadata (source, triggeredBy, formatVersion, entities).

BackupService is an application service that creates backups from RecordRepository/StatsRepository/AuditLogRepository data with SHA-256 checksums, exposes BackupStats, and provides restore via isBackupRestorable.

NotificationProvider is a provider configuration entity with type (email/sms/slack/webhook/in_app), status (active/inactive/suspended), channels (anomaly_detection/system_alerts/data_backup/user_activity/reports), and priority levels.

NotificationService is an application service that sends notifications through NotificationProviderRepository-managed providers, validates email recipients, and integrates with AnomalyDetectionService for anomaly alerts.

TrendAnalysis is a domain entity holding trend data points (date, emotion, recordCount) and student/class trend metrics with direction (up/down/stable), average/start/end emotion, volatility, topPerformers, and needsSupport.
TrendAnalysisService is an application service that computes moving averages and trend analyses over TrendAnalysisRepository data with a default window size of 3.
